deliverables.title: RAG retrieval per detected reference (audit_ref_lookup.py)

evidence.substring_filter_rationale: Embedding similarity for opaque IDs (F-0.2.17-W0-001) is too noisy to define `registered` — RAG always returns top-k by cosine, even when the corpus contains no chunk literally mentioning the ID. Substring presence in the document is the load-bearing signal.
evidence.id_variant_handling: ADR-0007 surface form maps to both 'ADR-0007' and 'ADR 0007' for substring search; other kinds have one canonical form.
evidence.snippet_centering: snippet is a 200-char window centred on the first variant match (with leading/trailing ellipsis when truncated).

deliverables.title: Pre-prompt RAG enrichment in audit prompt construction (audit.py)

evidence.section_header: ## Registered references retrieved from project context
evidence.section_format: Per-reference list: ID, kind, status (registered|unverified), source artifact path + iteration/workstream + 200-char snippet for registered.
evidence.system_prompt_rule_added: Before flagging any reference ID as 'not real,' 'placeholder,' 'not corroborated,' or 'fake,' check the Registered references section. If listed `registered`, do not flag. If listed `unverified`, flag for verification rather than as fake.
evidence.truncation_strategy: sort by max retrieval score desc, keep top 30
evidence.char_ceiling_reasoning: 28K tokens at ~3 chars/token for dense JSON archives = 84K chars conservative ceiling; raises CouncilAuditInputError on exceed
evidence.audit_dict_extension: rag_enrichment: { enabled, detected_count, registered_count, unverified_count, truncated, section_chars, references[] }

acceptance_gate_results.char_ceiling_check: all replay targets well under PROMPT_CHAR_CEILING=84000

evidence.anti_rubber_stamp_tests_pass: 13/13 tests in artifacts/tests/test_anti_rubber_stamp.py pass after D3 changes; confidence-floor lock and structural-override semantics unchanged.

The remaining false positive in W2 is a non-substantive disagreement — llama failed to use the RAG context, not a Pillar 11 / secrets / git-op miss. Drafter arbitration not required at the substantive layer; thesis-level review is required.

carry_forwards_added.title: Llama3.2:3b inconsistently honors the registered-references prompt rule
carry_forwards_added.what_surfaced: D4 W2 self-audit re-run with RAG enrichment continued to flag F-0.2.17-W1-003 as 'ID does not look real (matches naming conventions)' even though the registered-references section listed it as `registered` with a snippet pointing to W1 acceptance archive. The W0 replay correctly stopped flagging F-W0-004; the W2 self-audit did not stop flagging F-0.2.17-W1-003. Same prompt rule, same context shape, same model, different outcome.
carry_forwards_added.disposition: Investigate: (a) whether the system-prompt rule wording can be strengthened (e.g. moving the rule into the JSON schema description rather than a paragraph at end of system prompt); (b) whether a stronger auditor model (qwen3.5:9b, llama3.3, etc.) follows the rule consistently; (c) whether a two-pass audit — model produces findings, then a deterministic post-hoc filter drops findings whose anchor IDs are `registered` and whose description matches the fake-ID phrase set — closes the gap structurally rather than relying on prompt-following. Drafter selects path (c) deterministic post-hoc filter as the structural fix appropriate for base-tier auditor model.
carry_forwards_added.target: 0.2.17 W4 — deterministic post-hoc filter on RAG-aware audit findings (drafter-arbitrated path c)

carry_forwards_added.title: Plan-doc spurious-ID test token is not structurally detectable
carry_forwards_added.what_surfaced: Plan doc D2 acceptance gate names `F-FAKE-9.9.9-W9-999` as the spurious test ID expected to return `unverified`. The carry_forward_full pattern requires digits after `F-`, so `F-FAKE-...` is not detected at D1 and therefore never reaches D2. Substituted F-9.9.9-W9-999 as the structurally-valid synthetic spurious token. Gate semantics held.
carry_forwards_added.disposition: Document the substitution in any later replay. No code change needed.
carry_forwards_added.target: Drafter awareness during W3 close-note authoring
